name: Deacon Duties
overview: Scripture reveals that deacons serve the practical needs of the church, as seen in Acts 6:1 where they address the neglect of widows in daily ministry. While elders are called to shepherd and pray over the flock (Acts 20:28; James 5:14), deacons assist in supporting the church community, working alongside bishops as recognized in Philippians 1:1. Their role complements the gifts Christ has given to the church, including pastors and teachers, to build up the body of Christ (Ephesians 4:11).
